summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia Tbk announcing the summary of minutes of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders (AGM) for financial year 2025. The meeting was held on June 8, 2026, both physically and electronically via KSEI's eASY system. The filing details attendance, quorum (83.4% of voting shares), and lists the Board of Commissioners and Directors present. Absentees and share repurchase figures are noted. No extraordinary corporate action or special situation is disclosed; it is a routine procedural report required of foreign private issuers. Equivalent to a domestic Form 8-K item reporting annual meeting results.
